title: First Cloud <-> M5 Pro MacBook GoNext Relay Verification (XCFramework + macOS & iPadOS builds + CI check)
summary: End-to-end smoke test of the GoNext GitOps relay on M5 Pro MacBook Pro: records Apple toolchain info, verifies incremental 3-slice MangaCore.xcframework, regenerates Xcode project, compiles macOS & iPadOS targets headlessly, and runs local CI gate.
